items.en: Iranian drones strike Kuwait and Bahrain as Gulf states condemn attacks
items.zh: 伊朗無人機襲科威特、巴林，波灣國家譴責
items.summary: Kuwait said on Wednesday its air defences were countering hostile drone attacks, with explosions heard across the country coming from interceptions, though it did not name who launched them. Bahrain accused Iran of criminal attacks after issuing two danger alerts in quick succession and urged residents to stay calm. Iran's Revolutionary Guard had earlier described a drone barrage as a precision operation against a US radar at the Isa airbase, and launched six drones at a radar at Riffa airbase on Sunday. The US military said the drones were intercepted with no damage and no injuries. The GCC secretary general, Qatar and the UAE all condemned the strikes.

items.en: Xi pitches free trade at APEC as Trump arrives in Shenzhen
items.zh: 習近平 APEC 推自由貿易，川普抵達深圳
items.summary: Xi Jinping used the APEC summit in Shenzhen on Wednesday to urge free and open trade and to present China as a stable partner, pledging to uphold the WTO-centred trading system, lower tariffs, widen market access in manufacturing and services and pursue deep-seated reform. His attack on rising unilateralism and protectionism was read as veiled criticism of Donald Trump's America First tariffs. Leaders of APEC's 21 member economies attended. Trump flew in from the Philippines and was due to meet Xi later the same day, followed by an unprecedented three-way summit with Vladimir Putin. Washington still restricts Chinese access to Nvidia AI chips.

items.en: Nvidia rules out Huang's return as revenue doubles to $115.8bn
items.zh: 輝達營收倍增，董事會排除黃仁勳回任
items.summary: Nvidia reported third-quarter revenue of $115.8bn, up 103% year on year, and net profit of $64.9bn, up 109%, for the quarter ended October 25, and guided to about $130bn give or take 3% this quarter. Board chair Harvey Jones said directors unanimously accepted Jensen Huang's resignation over personal conduct inconsistent with company standards and do not plan to reinstate him. Colette Kress leads as interim chief executive while a permanent successor is sought. Huang said he would be honoured to return. Shares closed down 0.4% then rose 4.8% after hours, and are down more than 30% in a month.

items.en: Board of Peace warns Gaza ceasefire is close to collapse
items.zh: 和平委員會警告加薩停火瀁臨崩潰
items.summary: The US-backed Board of Peace, created in 2025 at Donald Trump's behest to oversee the Gaza ceasefire and reconstruction, told the UN Security Council on Tuesday that the truce may be on the brink of collapse without immediate steps to implement the 2025 deal. A ceasefire that delivers nothing visible cannot be sustained indefinitely, its report said. It urged Israel to decide without delay on training and deploying civilian police in Gaza and asked the Council to press both sides. Israeli restrictions have blocked life-saving aid before winter, and more than 74,000 Palestinians have been killed since October 2023.

items.en: Russian military cargo plane crashes in Siberia, killing 19
items.zh: 俄軍運輸機西伯利亞墜毀，19 人罹難
items.summary: An Antonov An-12, a Soviet-built four-engine turboprop military cargo aircraft in service since the late 1950s, crashed in an unpopulated area near Kemerovo in western Siberia, roughly 3,000km east of Moscow and close to the village of Yagunovo. The Russian Defence Ministry said all 19 people on board were killed, although the type normally carries a crew of six, and it did not identify the other passengers. Preliminary findings point to equipment failure. A commission from the Russian Aerospace Forces is investigating and the Investigative Committee has opened an inquiry into possible flight safety violations.

items.en: Apple services go down after an update goes awry
items.zh: Apple 更新出錯，iCloud、Apple Music 大規模中斷
items.summary: Multiple Apple services including Apple Music and iCloud went down on Tuesday after a software update went wrong, leaving users unable to reach stored files and streaming libraries for hours. The outage puts Apple on a growing list of technology breakdowns in recent days. Wall Street executives and the National Security Agency told Congress that several recent outages stemmed from a rushed effort to patch vulnerabilities discovered by AI tools, and the Federal Aviation Administration cancelled more than 20,000 flights during a related ground stop.

items.en: AMD launches Instinct MI350P with Microsoft and closes World Labs deal
items.zh: AMD 推 MI350P，並完成 82 億美元併購 World Labs
items.summary: AMD announced the Instinct MI350P accelerator on November 17 together with Microsoft, shipping with support for Windows Server 2025 and 2028, GPU partitioning and AMD Inference Microservices at launch. Separately AMD closed its $8.2 billion all-stock acquisition of World Labs on November 13, issuing about 14.98 million shares; co-founder Fei-Fei Li joins as executive vice-president and chief scientist reporting to Lisa Su. At SC26 AMD also argued its MI430X delivers native FP64 performance that beats Nvidia's emulation approach for high-performance computing workloads.

items.en: Microsoft puts Word, Excel and PowerPoint inside Copilot
items.zh: 微軟 Ignite：Office 三大應用正式進入 Copilot
items.summary: At Ignite, Microsoft made Word, Excel and PowerPoint generally available inside Copilot, with Satya Nadella describing Copilot as the new operating system for work. Pricing for Copilot Autopilot was not announced. Microsoft also unveiled Copilotforce, which pulls Salesforce context into Copilot, Teams and Fabric with more than thirty-eight prebuilt sales skills in public preview, with Accenture as pilot partner. A Microsoft executive separately told Bloomberg that the turmoil at Nvidia could accelerate customer interest in rival accelerators.

items.en: Pelicans rout Warriors as Fears becomes youngest to triple-double
items.zh: 鵜鶘 115:94 勇士，Fears 寫隊史最年輕大三元
items.summary: New Orleans beat Golden State 115-94, with Jeremiah Fears posting 19 points, 10 rebounds and 10 assists in 29 minutes. At 20 years and 33 days he became the youngest Pelicans player to record a triple-double, breaking a mark held by Chris Paul. The Warriors are navigating the stretch without Stephen Curry, who is out for at least two weeks with an oblique tear, and Draymond Green used the loss to urge the team not to place too much pressure on its rookies while the roster is shorthanded.

items.en: Timberwolves end Portland's three-game winning run
items.zh: 灰狼 106:98 開拓者，終止拓荒者三連勝
items.summary: Minnesota beat Portland 106-98, ending the Trail Blazers' three-game winning streak. Chinese centre Yang Hansen played 7 minutes 28 seconds in garbage time, finishing without a point but with one rebound, three assists and one steal; his plus-eleven matched a career high and the three assists tied his career best. Elsewhere Memphis beat Washington 136-120 despite missing several players, with a nineteen-year-old rookie scoring 25 points on five three-pointers.

items.en: Chinese player named MAC Player of the Week in a first
items.zh: 王俊杰獲 MAC 單週最佳，中國球員首見
items.summary: Wang Junjie of UMass was named Mid-American Conference Player of the Week after a career-high 28 points with nine rebounds and one block, the first time a Chinese player has taken the award in NCAA Division I. In other results, nineteen-year-old Li Yuxuan scored 13 points as Fujian lost 0-3 to Jiangsu in the third round of the volleyball league, and the entry list for the WTT Hong Kong table-tennis finals was confirmed with seven women's and three men's qualifiers.

items.en: Healthy Minds Study finds college mental health improving
items.zh: 美大學生心理健康回升，但需求仍大
items.summary: The University of Michigan's Healthy Minds Study reports that college student mental health has improved across its latest survey year, continuing a gradual recovery from pandemic-era lows in measures of depression and anxiety. Researchers caution that significant unmet need remains: a large share of students who screen positive for a condition still receive no treatment, and gaps persist by institution type and student background. The study is one of the largest annual surveys of its kind in higher education and is used widely to plan campus counselling capacity.

items.en: RAND finds supporting student mental health strains teachers
items.zh: RAND：照顧學生心理健康正消耗教師自身福祉
items.summary: RAND's 2026 State of the American Teacher survey finds that difficulty supporting student mental health is a significant drag on teacher well-being. Teachers who report struggling to help distressed students score worse on measures of job-related stress, burnout and intention to leave the profession than peers who feel equipped to respond. The authors argue that investment in school counselling and clear referral pathways functions as teacher-retention policy, not only student-welfare policy, and recommend schools stop treating the two concerns as separate budget lines.

items.en: UK regulator tells universities to teach AI skills and protect degrees
items.zh: 英國學生辦公室：教 AI 技能同時守住學位可信度
items.summary: England's Office for Students says universities should help students build artificial-intelligence skills while protecting public confidence in the value of degrees. Its guidance argues institutions cannot simply ban generative tools, because graduates will be expected to use them at work, but must redesign assessment so that a qualification still evidences the student's own learning. The regulator points to wide variation in current institutional practice and asks providers to be explicit with students about where AI use is permitted, where it is not, and how that boundary is checked.

items.en: Nvidia halts H200 sales in China as export rules tighten
items.zh: 輝達停售中國 H200，法人估營收少 440–620 億美元
items.summary: Interim chief executive Colette Kress said Nvidia will stop selling the H200 in China, ending an arrangement that carried a 25% tariff. Jefferies estimates the new export controls could cut $44 billion to $62 billion from revenue, though Kress argued backlog demand for the Vera Rubin generation would protect the top line. Nvidia also warned customers about the proposed Remote Access Security Act, which passed the House in January but not the Senate, saying it will stop selling to clients that rent more than half their GPU capacity to Chinese firms.

items.en: OpenAI ships GPT-6.2 in Astra and Sol variants
items.zh: OpenAI 推 GPT-6.2，分 Astra 專業版與 Sol 日常版
items.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6.2 in two configurations: Astra for complex professional work and Sol for everyday tasks. The company says Astra scores 5.2 points above GPT-6 Astra on Agents' Last Exam and nine points higher on Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1, and reports its cost on that first benchmark at roughly 5% of Claude Fable 5.2's. Separately Google is pushing agentic commerce, with Zalando planning checkout inside Google's AI Mode and the Gemini app for a shopping service due to launch in 2027.

items.en: Nvidia, IBM and Fermilab open a quantum co-design effort
items.zh: 輝達、IBM、費米實驗室啟動量子協同設計
items.summary: At SC26 in Chicago, Nvidia's Ian Buck announced a quantum computing co-design collaboration between Nvidia, IBM and Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory, aimed at pairing quantum processors with classical GPU infrastructure rather than treating them as separate stacks. The same keynote covered Nemotron for Science and expansions to the Rubin HPC GPU and Vera CPU lines. In Taiwan, local reporting says TSMC is weighing a move into advanced memory, including 3D DRAM for Nvidia, with Korean media warning the AI chip supply chain could consolidate further.

items.en: Ado, YOASOBI, Vaundy and Mrs. GREEN APPLE make the 77th Kohaku
items.zh: 第 77 回紅白名單出爐，清單內四組入選
items.summary: NHK has announced the line-up for the 77th Kohaku Uta Gassen, airing on December 31 from 19:20 to 23:45. Four acts from the watchlist made the cut: Ado and YOASOBI on the Red team, with Vaundy and Mrs. GREEN APPLE on the White team. The twenty Red and twenty-one White acts include SAKANACTION and L'Arc-en-Ciel, while =LOVE, CUTIE STREET, Ayumu Imazu and Macaroni Empitsu make first appearances. King Gnu, Kenshi Yonezu, Fujii Kaze, Official HIGE DANdism and LiSA are not on this year's list.

items.en: YOASOBI release KILLA, their first track arranged outside Ayase
items.zh: YOASOBI 新曲〈KILLA〉首度由 Ayase 以外編曲
items.summary: YOASOBI released the digital single KILLA on November 11, with Tsumiki handling the arrangement. It is the first YOASOBI track arranged by someone other than Ayase, and the source story is a debut work by a new writer, keeping to the duo's practice of building songs from fiction. The release lands mid-way through their 2026-2027 arena and dome run, whose Sapporo show on November 15 ran twenty-three songs, and ahead of their two Taipei Dome nights on January 9 and 10, 2027.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE set a sixth album and their first arena tour in three years
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 公布第六張專輯與三年來首度巡迴
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE have confirmed a release date for their sixth studio album and announced their first arena tour in three years, extending a roadmap the band has already sketched out as far as 2029. Near-term items include the Ringo Jam fan-club arena run covering thirteen cities, followed by a further staging project and a costume exhibition in 2027. No Taiwan date has been confirmed in the current schedule, so fans in Taipei are still waiting on a first local booking from the band.

items.en: YOASOBI's Taipei Dome nights stay the headline Taiwan booking
items.zh: YOASOBI 2027/1/9–10 台北大巨蛋仍是台灣最大場
items.summary: YOASOBI's two Taipei Dome shows on January 9 and 10, 2027 remain the biggest Japanese booking on the Taiwan calendar, sold through real-name registration and a lottery rather than first-come sales, so entry depends on the draw. Taiwan has had an unusually dense J-pop touring year: Vaundy played Taipei Arena on October 31 and November 1, and Fujii Kaze gave Taiwan his first overseas date of the cycle. Hong Kong and Japan fans are accommodated under the same registration scheme.
